title: VTC — shared relationship lifecycle definitions
description: Shared types for vtc/relationships/{suspend,restore}: an edge's resolved state after a lifecycle event. Not itself a Trust Task specification (the `_shared` folder is skipped by the registry build and the codegen).

LifecycleReason.title: LifecycleReason
LifecycleReason.description: Why the edge was suspended or restored, stored verbatim on the lifecycle event. Free text written by the caller — the edge's issuer or a moderating administrator — and read by the counterparty and by administrators; retained with the edge. Untrusted, attributed to its author wherever rendered, and never read by the community's state machine.

InForce.title: InForce
InForce.description: Whether the edge is in force now, and if not, why not — the edge's resolved state, which is not the same thing as the event just recorded: restoring an edge whose `validUntil` passed while it was suspended records the restoration and still resolves `expired`. Exactly the members its `state` names are present.

state.description: `yes`: inside its window, nothing standing against it. `notYetValid`: its `validFrom` has not arrived. `expired`: its `validUntil` has passed. `suspended`: temporarily ineffective — the only non-`yes` state a lifecycle event can reverse. `superseded`: displaced by a later credential. `withdrawn`: terminal. `indeterminate`: the credential's own window could not be read, so no honest answer is available.

since.description: Present for `suspended`: when the standing suspension was recorded.

by.description: Present for `superseded`: the digest of the credential that displaced it.

reason.description: Present for `indeterminate`: why the window could not be read. Written by the community.
